title: Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing villa construction projects from initiation to final handover. The role involves managing site activities, subcontractors, consultants, materials, budgets, quality standards, and project schedules to ensure the villa project is completed safely, within budget, on time, and according to approved drawings and specifications.

Key Responsibilities1. Project Planning and Execution

* Develop detailed project schedules, construction plans, and execution strategies.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly construction progress.
* Ensure work is carried out according to approved architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
* Coordinate all construction activities from foundation to finishing and handover.
* Identify project risks and implement corrective actions to avoid delays.

2. Site and Team Management

* Supervise site engineers, supervisors, foremen, subcontractors, and other project staff.
* Coordinate civil, structural, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, landscaping, and interior finishing works.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Ensure effective communication between clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.

3. Budget and Cost Control

* Prepare and monitor project budgets and cost forecasts.
* Control construction expenses and minimize material wastage.
* Review bills, subcontractor invoices, and variations.
* Monitor quantities, material consumption, and resource utilization.
* Report cost overruns and recommend cost-saving measures without compromising quality.

4. Quality Control

* Ensure construction work complies with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
* Inspect concrete, masonry, waterproofing, tiling, painting, joinery, and other finishing works.
* Coordinate inspections and resolve technical issues.
* Ensure all defects and non-conformities are corrected promptly.

5. Procurement and Material Management

* Coordinate with the procurement team to ensure timely delivery of materials.
* Review material requirements and construction specifications.
* Monitor material availability, storage, and usage at the site.
* Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors to prevent work interruptions.

6. Health, Safety, and Compliance

* Ensure compliance with site safety procedures and applicable construction regulations.
* Conduct safety inspections and ensure workers use appropriate personal protective equipment.
* Maintain proper site housekeeping and safe working conditions.
* Ensure necessary permits, inspections, and approvals are obtained.

7. Client and Consultant Coordination

* Attend client meetings and provide regular project progress updates.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, and other stakeholders.
* Manage client requirements, approved changes, and variation orders.
* Resolve site issues and ensure client expectations are met.

8. Project Completion and Handover

* Prepare and monitor the snagging and de-snagging process.
* Ensure testing and commissioning of all building services.
* Coordinate final inspections and completion documentation.
* Arrange preparation of as-built drawings, warranties, and operation and maintenance manuals.
* Ensure timely handover of completed villas to the client.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–10 years of experience in construction project management, preferably in residential villas or luxury residential projects.
* Strong knowledge of civil construction, MEP coordination, and finishing works.
* Experience in project scheduling, budgeting, procurement, and subcontractor management.
* Proficiency in MS Project, Primavera P6, AutoCAD, and MS Excel is an advantage.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

The Project Coordinator / Associate Project Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management of Scaleios customer projects across Azure, Microsoft 365 and AWS. It is ideal for a structured, proactive individual who thrives on ownership, follow-through and cross-functional coordination.

Project Planning & Timeline Management

* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for assigned projects throughout the lifecycle, from kick-off call to handover.
* Prepare and proactively maintain Project Plans in the project management tool (e.g., MS Planner) in coordination with the Technical Project Team and customer, capturing tasks, owners, effort and timelines.

Stakeholder Management & Status Reporting

* Share regular project status reports with the respective stakeholders, including after every key meeting or decision point.

Scope, Risk & Escalation Management

* Proactively identify and flag timeline lapses, risks and blockers to the Project Lead before they become escalations.
* Call out and formally report any scope creep or deviation in the proposed solution, in coordination with the Customer, Technical and Sales teams.
* Own and track project-level escalations to resolution, following the correct escalation matrix and communication path.

Project Onboarding, Handover & Transition

* Own the project onboarding process end to end - collect all required onboarding data from the Sales/Account Management team and follow the standard onboarding process for every assigned project.
* Conduct the project kick-off call, with onboarding and subsequent project activities commencing immediately thereafter.
* Conduct formal handover sessions for large projects and prepare handover documentation (solution overview, resource details, support scope, contacts and escalation matrix).
* Ensure a smooth transition into the Support team immediately after handover for customers who have opted for support, with all relevant details formally handed over.

Process Adherence & Documentation

* Ensure consistent use of the proper project management tools and processes across all assigned projects.
* Maintain complete, up-to-date internal project documentation, and help standardize and communicate the onboarding-to-handover process to the PreSales, Sales and BizOps teams.
